h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bidar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bidar

items.pText: Bidar sits on a laterite plateau in the far north-east of Karnataka, near the Telangana and Maharashtra borders. The old fort and the red, rocky ground are the first things most visitors notice. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Bidar's schools, colleges, defence-area colonies and municipal parks. We build it at our Vasai factory, about 510 km away, and install it with our team or a dealer.

Rocky laterite can be both easy and hard to build on. It is firm, so equipment stays put once fixed, but digging footings takes more effort than in soft soil. That is why we ask for site photos before suggesting an installation method. On paved or very hard ground, some pieces can be set self-standing. On open rocky ground, posts are usually grouted into concrete footings cut into the rock.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing an installation method for rocky ground

c: We offer two methods. Grouting sets the posts in concrete footings below ground level and suits most open sites. A self-standing base sits on a firm, level surface and suits paved courtyards or areas where digging is not allowed.

Laterite drains quickly, but loose gravel on top can be uncomfortable for falls. Lay rubber flooring on a levelled base under swings and slides. Bidar's plateau is a little milder than the plains around it, though summers are still hot. A

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on rock or laterite?
items.a: Yes. On open rocky ground we usually grout posts into concrete footings. On a paved, level courtyard, some pieces can be set on a self-standing base. Site photos help us decide.

items.q: What is the difference between grouting and self-standing?
items.a: Grouting fixes the posts in concrete below ground level. Self-standing equipment rests on its own base on a firm, level surface, which helps where digging is not possible.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Bidar?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from Vasai, about 510 km away, by road and install it with our team or a dealer in Karnataka.
